site: Fal AI application 106; narrative experience questions across portals
class: Review demands undocumented direct experience despite related-experience policy
symptom: The restarted worker left the Linux/SDN narrative blank. A live Gemini reproduction rejected CNI/SDN experience and requested sysctl or eBPF examples, causing the rewrite to imply undocumented kernel configuration.
root_cause: The reviewer instruction to cover every requested part overrode its weaker allowance for related experience. Feedback demanded direct projects rather than an explicit relevance explanation.
why_tests_missed: Mock verdict tests verified acceptance plumbing but did not establish live-model compliance with competing prompt instructions.
fix: Give the related-experience rule explicit precedence for narratives, require a relevance explanation, and forbid converting platform implementation details into personal hands-on claims. Exact factual questions still require evidence.
prevention: Validate prompt changes with live model output as well as deterministic contract tests. Review feedback must not pressure the writer to fabricate direct experience.
